budget_cap_consistency_analysis.explanation: A 25 GB (25,000,000,000 bytes) cap at $6.25/TiB yields $0.1421 USD, exceeding the $0.125 cap by $0.0171 USD (+13.7%).

sandbox_no_billing_evaluation.quota_exhaustion_governance: Sandbox queries do not incur paid charges. However, if monthly usage across all sandbox queries exceeds 1 TiB, BigQuery halts execution with QuotaExceededError. Sandbox queries are NOT unconditionally free beyond 1 TiB.

provisional_estimates_status.evidence_basis: Calculated analytically from uncompressed column widths in protobuf schemas and published daily event volumes for cell_a. MUST NOT be represented as a verified service response. Actual BigQuery service dry run will provide the true billable bytes once credentials are provided.
